descriptions.CN: [h1]房车生活 3.9[/h1]把受支持的车辆改装成移动生活空间，安装床铺、储物柜、家电和车顶装备。支持 B42.20 单人、多人及专用服务器。[h2]功能特色[/h2][list][*]车内生活：安装床铺、柜台、储物柜、小冰箱、微波炉和电视，在车内休息、收纳和使用设备。[*]饮水与供电：车载电源支持生活设备；配备水箱的车型支持储水、净化和液体转移。耗电可通过沙盒选项调整。[*]车顶装备：为受支持的原版车型安装行李架、发电机、储物箱、帐篷、油罐、瓦斯罐及备胎。[*]车顶射灯：独立安装，使用车辆主电瓶供电，随原车大灯开关。[*]车辆防护：焊接安装车窗护甲和前后防撞杠，具有独立耐久与破损外观；拆毁可回收部分材料。[*]快捷使用：行李架上的瓦斯罐及车辆水箱可以在车旁边直接使用。[*]底盘改良：可以大幅提升车辆负重能力。[*]快捷菜单：可以直接在车身附近对行李架上的发电机、汽油罐、瓦斯罐和自带水箱进行快捷操作。沙盒可关闭。[*]小电器：可换装咖啡机或烤面包机，使用副电瓶供电。车内闪电入口与物品右键制作共用原版配方，支持连续制作；未安装时不显示入口。[/list][h2]支持范围[/h2][list][*]原版 StepVan、Van、SUV、PickUpVan 及指定变种，包括邮政版。客运 Van 可安装车顶装备，不增加车内生活空间。[*]不改装 PickUpTruck、指定警用／救护／广播等特殊车型，以及损毁、烧毁车辆。[*]可选 KI5 Campers! 适配，为六款受支持房车增加生活设备位与净水箱，同时保留原有座位、床位和储物功能。车顶改装及新增护甲限受支持的原版车型。[/list][h2]启用方式[/h2][list][*]原版车辆：启用 VehicleLivingSlots，无需其他 Mod。[*]KI5 房车：额外启用 VehicleLivingSlotsKI5Campers，并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3670064951]KI5 Campers![/url] 和 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url]。[*]通过车辆维修界面安装设备，所需材料、工具和技能以菜单提示为准。固定设施采用拆毁方式移除。[*]多人游戏客户端与服务器须使用一致版本。[/list][b]Workshop ID:[/b] 3791192579[b]Mod ID:[/b] VehicleLivingSlots
descriptions.CH: [h1]房車生活 3.9[/h1]把受支援的車輛改裝成移動生活空間，安裝床鋪、儲物櫃、家電和車頂裝備。支援 B42.20 單人、多人及專用伺服器。[h2]功能特色[/h2][list][*]車內生活：安裝床鋪、櫃檯、儲物櫃、小冰箱、微波爐和電視，在車內休息、收納和使用設備。[*]飲水與供電：車載電源支援生活設備；配備水箱的車型支援儲水、淨化和液體轉移。耗電可透過沙盒選項調整。[*]車頂裝備：為受支援的原版車型安裝行李架、發電機、儲物箱、帳篷、油罐、瓦斯罐及備胎。[*]車頂射燈：獨立安裝，使用車輛主電瓶供電，隨原車大燈開關。[*]車輛防護：焊接安裝車窗護甲和前後防撞桿，具有獨立耐久與破損外觀；拆毀可回收部分材料。[*]快捷使用：行李架上的瓦斯罐及車輛水箱可以在車旁邊直接使用。[*]底盤改良：可以大幅提升車輛負重能力。[*]快捷選單：可以直接在車身附近對行李架上的發電機、汽油罐、瓦斯罐和自帶水箱進行快捷操作。沙盒可關閉。[*]小電器：可換裝咖啡機或烤麵包機，使用副電瓶供電。車內閃電入口與物品右鍵製作共用原版配方，支援連續製作；未安裝時不顯示入口。[/list][h2]支援範圍[/h2][list][*]原版 StepVan、Van、SUV、PickUpVan 及指定變種，包括郵政版。客運 Van 可安裝車頂裝備，不增加車內生活空間。[*]不改裝 PickUpTruck、指定警用／救護／廣播等特殊車型，以及損毀、燒毀車輛。[*]可選 KI5 Campers! 適配，為六款受支援房車增加生活設備位與淨水箱，同時保留原有座位、床位和儲物功能。車頂改裝及新增護甲限受支援的原版車型。[/list][h2]啟用方式[/h2][list][*]原版車輛：啟用 VehicleLivingSlots，無需其他 Mod。[*]KI5 房車：額外啟用 VehicleLivingSlotsKI5Campers，並安裝 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3670064951]KI5 Campers![/url] 和 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url]。[*]透過車輛維修介面安裝設備，所需材料、工具和技能以選單提示為準。固定設施採用拆毀方式移除。[*]多人遊戲客戶端與伺服器須使用一致版本。[/list][b]Workshop ID:[/b] 3791192579 [b]Mod ID:[/b] VehicleLivingSlots
descriptions.EN: [h1]Mobile Living 3.9[/h1]Turn supported vehicles into mobile living spaces with beds, storage, appliances and roof equipment. Supports B42.20 single-player, multiplayer and dedicated servers.[h2]Features[/h2][list][*]Living space: fit beds, counters, storage cabinets, mini fridges, microwaves and televisions for resting, storage and appliance use.[*]Water and power: vehicle power supplies living equipment. Vehicles with tank slots support water storage, purification and fluid transfers. Power consumption is configurable in sandbox settings.[*]Roof equipment: fit supported vanilla vehicles with racks, generators, storage boxes, packed tents, fuel cans, propane tanks and spare tyres.[*]Roof spotlights: install individually; powered by the main vehicle battery and switched with the original headlights.[*]Vehicle protection: weld on window armor and front/rear bumper guards with separate durability and damage visuals. Destructive removal recovers some materials.[*] Quick Access: Propane tanks stored on the roof rack and vehicle water tanks can be used directly while standing beside the vehicle.[*] Improved Chassis: Significantly increases the vehicle's carrying capacity.[*]Quick menus: Directly operate the roof-rack generator, petrol cans, propane tanks, and built-in water tanks while standing near the vehicle. These menus can be disabled in Sandbox Options.[*]Small appliances: install a coffee maker or toaster powered by the auxiliary battery. The interior lightning shortcut and inventory-item Craft menu share native recipes and support repeated crafting. Empty slots have no radial entry.[/list][h2]Supported vehicles[/h2][list][*]Vanilla StepVan, Van, SUV, PickUpVan and selected variants, including postal vans. Passenger Vans support roof equipment without added interior living spaces.[*]PickUpTrucks, specified police/ambulance/broadcast variants, wrecks and burnt vehicles are excluded.[*]Optional KI5 Campers! support adds living-equipment slots and clean-water tanks to six supported campers while retaining their original seats, beds and storage. Roof upgrades and added armor are limited to supported vanilla vehicles.[/list][h2]Setup[/h2][list][*]Vanilla vehicles: enable VehicleLivingSlots. No other Mod is required.[*]KI5 campers: also enable VehicleLivingSlotsKI5Campers and install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3670064951]KI5 Campers![/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url].[*]Use the vehicle mechanics menu to install equipment. The menu lists required materials, tools and skills. Fixed fittings require destructive removal.[*]Multiplayer clients and servers must use matching versions. [/list][b]Workshop ID:[/b] 3791192579[b]Mod ID:[/b] VehicleLivingSlots
